findings.title: Defer correctness and explanation during mock exam
evidence: packages/qualification_app/lib/src/production_app.dart renders answer feedback and explanation after every committed response without a mock-exam exception
apps/drone_second_class/app.yaml enables a 50-question timed mock exam
findings.user_impact: In-exam feedback changes a timed practice session into guided practice and can influence later answers.
acceptance_criteria: Mock-exam commit reveals no correctness, correct choice, explanation, or source before completion
Deadline and completion scoring remain deterministic
Feedback is available only through post-exam result/review

findings.title: Provide intentional leave-to-Home and resume flow
evidence: QualificationQuizPage has no close, Home, pause, or back action
QualificationProductionController.returnHome is exposed only from result while active sessions are persisted and Home already supports resume
findings.user_impact: A learner must finish a session or terminate/background the app to leave normal practice.
acceptance_criteria: Practice exposes an explicit leave-to-Home action that preserves the active session
Home exposes resume for the preserved session
Timed mock retains wall-clock deadline semantics and is not silently paused

findings.title: Eliminate silent no-op practice actions
evidence: Practice-mode buttons are enabled by feature flag rather than eligible-question count
startIncorrect and startUnanswered can pass an empty selection to _startSession, which returns false without UI feedback
findings.user_impact: Visible learning actions can appear broken when no eligible questions exist.
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility is represented before tap where practical or a clear empty-state response is shown
No enabled learning action fails silently
Empty-state behavior has widget coverage

findings.title: Establish a deterministic primary action on Home
evidence: Home stacks progress, all units, all practice modes, weakness, recommendation, history, and purchase
Recommendation appears below the feature list rather than as the primary next action
findings.user_impact: The learner must interpret the product structure instead of being guided toward the next useful study action.
acceptance_criteria: Home follows a deterministic primary-action hierarchy such as resume, review, weakness/recommendation, then start learning
Secondary modes remain discoverable without competing equally with the primary action
Hierarchy is covered by state-driven widget tests

findings.title: Make the correct answer explicit in practice feedback
evidence: After commit the UI shows only correctness text and explanation
Disabled choice tiles do not explicitly distinguish the correct choice after an incorrect response
findings.user_impact: The learner must infer the correct option from prose.
acceptance_criteria: Practice feedback distinguishes selected and correct answers
Correctness is not communicated by color alone
Long Japanese choice text remains readable at large text scale

findings.title: Expose per-question source provenance
evidence: QuizCard preserves sourceId, sourceTitle, sourceSection, and sourceVersion
Drone runtime questions contain those fields
Production quiz currently renders explanation only
findings.user_impact: Official-source traceability exists in data but is invisible to the learner.
acceptance_criteria: Reusable source presentation shows title, version, and section when present
Practice shows source after commit
Mock exam shows source only in post-exam review
Missing source fields fail gracefully

findings.title: Standardize loading, failure, and nonfatal status UX
evidence: Loading is an unlabeled CircularProgressIndicator
Fatal loading displays the raw exception string
Controller actions can return false without a shared status surface
findings.user_impact: Failure recovery and accessibility are inconsistent and internal error details may leak into learner-facing copy.
acceptance_criteria: Loading has semantic and user-readable status
Fatal errors use stable user copy and a safe recovery path where possible
Expected nonfatal failures use a shared message/state mechanism

findings.title: Add compact-width, large-text, long-content, and semantics gates
evidence: Shared widget coverage primarily uses one 800x1800 viewport
No durable compact-width or large-text gate covers Home, long Japanese content, or the mock progress/timer AppBar
findings.user_impact: Overflow or clipped controls can escape CI on small devices or with accessibility text settings.
acceptance_criteria: Widget tests cover compact phone width and large text scaling
Long Japanese question and choice fixtures preserve scrolling and action reachability
Mock progress/timer header remains usable
Essential state changes have appropriate semantics

findings.title: Remove manually maintained question total from Drone headline
evidence: apps/drone_second_class/app.yaml hard-codes 教則第5版を基にした全100問
Home separately derives current question counts from the runtime bank
Question Bank expansion is a separate active workstream
findings.user_impact: A legitimate bank expansion can produce stale or contradictory product copy.
acceptance_criteria: Drone headline does not embed a manually maintained total or the total is generated from authoritative runtime data
Visible question totals have one authoritative source

findings.title: Add one defensible Drone-specific product UX seam
evidence: DroneProductionBootstrap delegates directly to QualificationProductionBootstrap
Current product differentiation is manifest/content driven only
findings.user_impact: The reference product does not yet make full use of Drone-specific source, exam-area, and learning-path context.
acceptance_criteria: At least one Drone-specific presentation is tied to official source, exam structure, or learning path rather than cosmetic duplication
Implementation composes Factory extension/configuration seams
Shared controllers, persistence, selection algorithms, purchase handling, and standard screens are not forked

findings.title: Provide post-exam review after mock completion
evidence: Current result shows score/pass state and optional incorrect retry but no completed-attempt review surface
findings.user_impact: After in-exam feedback is removed, learners need a separate way to learn from the completed mock.
acceptance_criteria: Completed mock review exposes recorded answer, correct answer, explanation, and source where available
Review cannot mutate the completed attempt
Retry is a separate new attempt

findings.title: Define optional knowledge-target seam for finer weakness UX
evidence: Factory architecture allows optional knowledge-target metrics
Current answer events persist knowledgeTarget as null and QuizCard has no knowledge-target field
findings.user_impact: Weakness guidance cannot become more precise than broad units even when authoring data has finer concepts.
acceptance_criteria: Define a backward-compatible optional knowledge-target seam before exposing finer weakness UX
Preserve unit-level behavior when no target exists

findings.title: Make history optionally inspectable
evidence: Home shows the five latest completed sessions as read-only score rows
findings.user_impact: Past-session context cannot be inspected or reused directly.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate a history-detail/review entry point after P0/P1 flows are stable
Reuse post-mock review contracts rather than duplicate them

findings.title: Normalize learner-facing terminology
evidence: Visible production labels mix Japanese with implementation/product terms such as 解説（Explanation） and Full Unlock
findings.user_impact: Terminology consistency and product polish are weaker than necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Adopt consistent learner-facing terminology
Keep developer/internal terms out of visible production copy unless intentionally branded

findings.title: Connect progress state more directly to action
evidence: Progress shows completion and attempt counts while recommendation is a separate lower Home surface
findings.user_impact: Progress explains state but does not itself reduce the next-action decision burden.
acceptance_criteria: Address primarily through the Home primary-action hierarchy before adding more metrics
Do not introduce unsupported pass probability or real-exam-ability claims
